name: lothlorienblade
description: Agent Skills by lothlorienblade: codebase audits, behavior-preserving architectural refactoring, image generation through the Codex CLI, and distilling transcripts and chats into factual documents.

plugins.name: codebase-audit
plugins.description: Read-only codebase audit that produces a prioritized, verified list of problems to fix before development continues.

plugins.name: modular-architecture-refactor
plugins.description: Behavior-preserving architectural refactoring toward orthogonal, loosely coupled, highly cohesive, plugin-ready modules.

plugins.name: codex-imagegen
plugins.description: Generates raster images (sprites, textures, icons, backgrounds) through the OpenAI Codex CLI's built-in image generator, billed to a ChatGPT plan.

plugins.name: text-distill
plugins.description: Rewrites transcripts, recordings, essays, and chat exports into factual, structured documents with no filler, keeping who said what.
